text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, mana is surging throughout my 
body...! I feel it, the inheritance of 
sacred power...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Beloved and blessed even by the Goddesses 
of this world... Oh, isn't that just so 
saintly of me?♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Dear Three Goddesses, please continue to 
watch over the exploits of the one 
destined to become the Saint of an 
Alternate World!
